name: Saved progress triggers the resume modal and Continue restores it
description: After answering a question on the take page, the Start page offers a resume modal; Continue returns the user to the assessment. Assertions avoid numeric progress values because the modal's answered-count (1 of 36) and the take page's current-position (2 of 36) are different metrics that previously confused the verdict engine into a false block.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the Solstice take page
Click the numbered answer option 4 for the first question
Click the 'Begin Your Arc' link in the site header to go to the Start page
Verify a 'Pick up where you left off?' resume modal is open on the Start page.
Click the 'Continue' button in the resume modal
Verify the browser returns to the Solstice take page showing an assessment question with a numbered answer scale, confirming the saved progress was restored.
